title: Back to the Dictionary Form
description: See an adjective form, find the word you'd look up: 高くなかった → 高い, 静かじゃない → 静か.

points.title: From an い-adjective form
points.summary: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
points.body:
**Two kinds of adjectives**

- **い-adjectives** (高い, 新しい, おいしい) change their ending: drop い → 高**くない**, 高**かった**, 高**くなかった**, 高**くて**, 高**く** (adverb).
- **な-adjectives** (静か, 便利, 有名) never change; the words after them do: 静か**だ**, 静か**じゃない**, 静か**だった**, 静か**で**, 静か**に**, 静か**な**町.
- **Traps:** きれい, 嫌い, 有名, 丁寧 end in an い sound but are **な-adjectives** → きれいじゃない (not きれくない).
- **いい** is irregular: よくない, よかった, よくて, よさそう — only the present stays いい. かっこいい works the same way.

**Quick check:** before a noun, a な-adjective needs な (静か**な**部屋), an い-adjective doesn't (高い部屋).

points.summary: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself

questions.prompt:
{高|たか}くなかった → （　）
→ dictionary form
questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
高くなかった: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **高い**.

Example: その{時計|とけい}は**{高|たか}くなかった**。
questions.translation: That watch wasn't expensive. (高い = expensive, high)

questions.prompt:
{静|しず}かじゃない → （　）
→ dictionary form
questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
静かじゃない: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **静か**.

Example: この{辺|へん}は{夜|よる}も**{静|しず}かじゃない**。
questions.translation: This area isn't quiet even at night. (静か = quiet)

questions.hint: よ- forms come from いい
questions.explanation:
よかった: よ- (よくない, よかった) is the irregular stem of いい → **いい**.

Example: {旅行|りょこう}の{間|あいだ}、ずっと{天気|てんき}が**よかった**。
questions.translation: The weather was good throughout the trip. (いい = good)

questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
おいしそう: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **おいしい**.

Example: このケーキ、**おいしそう**！
questions.translation: This cake looks delicious! (おいしい = tasty)

questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
便利な: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **便利**.

Example: **{便利|べんり}な**アプリを{見|み}つけた。
questions.translation: I found a handy app. (便利 = convenient)

questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
寒くて: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **寒い**.

Example: **{寒|さむ}くて**、{手|て}が{冷|つめ}たい。
questions.translation: It's so cold my hands are freezing. (寒い = cold (weather))

questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
元気で: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **元気**.

Example: {祖母|そぼ}は**{元気|げんき}で**、{毎日|まいにち}{散歩|さんぽ}している。
questions.translation: My grandmother is in good health and takes a walk every day. (元気 = well, lively)

questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
早く: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **早い**.

Example: {明日|あした}は**{早|はや}く**{起|お}きます。
questions.translation: I'm getting up early tomorrow. (早い = early)

questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
上手に: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **上手**.

Example: {娘|むすめ}は**{上手|じょうず}に**{絵|え}を{描|か}く。
questions.translation: My daughter draws well. (上手 = good at)

questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
楽しかった: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **楽しい**.

Example: {友達|ともだち}と{話|はな}せて**{楽|たの}しかった**。
questions.translation: It was fun talking with my friends. (楽しい = fun)

questions.prompt:
{有名|ゆうめい}だった → （　）
→ dictionary form
questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
有名だった: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **有名**. ⚠ The い of きれい / 嫌い / 有名 / 丁寧 belongs to the word — they're な-adjectives.

Example: {祖父|そふ}は{村|むら}で**{有名|ゆうめい}だった**。
questions.translation: My grandfather was well known in the village. (有名 = famous)

questions.prompt:
かっこよくない → （　）
→ dictionary form
questions.hint: よ- forms come from いい
questions.explanation:
かっこよくない: よ- (よくない, よかった) is the irregular stem of いい → **かっこいい**.

Example: その{髪型|かみがた}、あまり**かっこよくない**よ。
questions.translation: That hairstyle isn't very cool. (かっこいい = cool, good-looking)

questions.prompt:
きれいじゃなかった → （　）
→ dictionary form
questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
きれいじゃなかった: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **きれい**. ⚠ The い of きれい / 嫌い / 有名 / 丁寧 belongs to the word — they're な-adjectives.

Example: {昔|むかし}、この{川|かわ}は**きれいじゃなかった**。
questions.translation: This river didn't use to be clean. (きれい = pretty, clean)

questions.prompt:
{難|むずか}しければ → （　）
→ dictionary form
questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
難しければ: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **難しい**.

Example: **{難|むずか}しければ**、{先生|せんせい}に{聞|き}いてください。
questions.translation: If it's difficult, ask the teacher. (難しい = difficult)

questions.hint: じゃ / だ / で / な / に after the word → the word itself
questions.explanation:
嫌いだった: a な-adjective: the word never changes, just drop what follows → **嫌い**. ⚠ The い of きれい / 嫌い / 有名 / 丁寧 belongs to the word — they're な-adjectives.

Example: {昔|むかし}は{野菜|やさい}が**{嫌|きら}いだった**。
questions.translation: I used to hate vegetables. (嫌い = disliked)

questions.hint: く / かっ / けれ / そう / すぎる after the stem → put い back
questions.explanation:
大きすぎる: an い-adjective: the い dropped for the ending, so add it back → **大きい**.

Example: このシャツは{私|わたし}には**{大|おお}きすぎる**。
questions.translation: This shirt is too big for me. (大きい = big)
